description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the EncounterTypeValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It tests validation logic such as required fields, field lengths, duplicate detection, and editing existing EncounterType instances.

classes.name: EncounterTypeValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating EncounterType objects using EncounterTypeValidator, including validation of null/empty fields, duplicates, length constraints, and proper handling during edits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the EncounterType's name is null, empty, or only whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when the description is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all required fields are properly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationWhenEditingAnExistingEncounterType
methods.description: Tests validation for an existing EncounterType retrieved from the context.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterTypeNameIsDuplicate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if an EncounterType with a duplicate name exists.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation passes when field lengths are within specified limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation fails when field lengths exceed their maximum limits.
